_comment: Published extensions offered at the end of setup and by `herald ext available`. Each is someone's own repository; add yours with a pull request. Tag the repository herald-extension so it also appears at https://github.com/topics/herald-extension.

extensions.name: canvas
extensions.title: Canvas LMS
extensions.summary: Courses, grades, submissions and announcements from Canvas, with courses you can limit to dates and grades only.

extensions.name: umd
extensions.title: UMD campus events
extensions.summary: Campus events on a Google calendar of their own, each judged once against criteria you write.

extensions.name: transit
extensions.title: DC-area transit
extensions.summary: Live Metrobus, Metrorail and Ride On arrivals, alerts and trip planning, from where you are.

extensions.name: shop
extensions.title: Clothes shopping
extensions.summary: Clothes in your sizes from H&M, Uniqlo, Old Navy and Kohl's, with a contact sheet of photos.

extensions.name: discord
extensions.title: Discord
extensions.summary: Messages from the servers and DMs your own client sees, forwarded by a Vencord plugin, with chosen club channels read for events and opportunities.
